infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: FoundingOS Quantum uses the camera to scan shelves, receipts, product labels, and workflow media for AI-assisted actions.
infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: FoundingOS Quantum uses the microphone to capture voice commands for AI-assisted workflows.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: FoundingOS Quantum uses your photo library to select receipts, product photos, videos, and workflow media for AI-assisted actions.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryAddUsageDescription: FoundingOS Quantum may save generated receipts, workflow captures, and AI confirmation assets to your photo library when requested.
